# Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pāṭidesanīya 1 (Bi-Vb Pd1)
**ID:** Bi-Vb Pd1
**Section:** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga (bi-vb)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pāṭidesanīya 1
**Title (English, from literature):** The training rule on asking for ghee

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
*Sappiviññāpana* ("The training rule on asking for ghee", Bi-Vb Pd 1) constitutes the first rule of the Pāṭidesanīya chapter of the *Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga* in the Vinaya Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The training rule governs the conduct of Buddhist nuns regarding the procurement of clarified butter (*sappi*), specifically addressing the disciplinary fault incurred when an unordained or healthy nun solicits ghee for her own consumption [SuttaCentral]. An English translation of the rule, including its word commentary and case-law analysis, is provided by Bhikkhu Brahmali on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
The rule is widely preserved across early Buddhist monastic codes. SuttaCentral identifies direct parallels in the Pali *Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha* (Bi-Pm Pd 1) and the *Bhikkhunī Parivāra*, as well as corresponding rules in the Bhikṣuṇī Vibhaṅgas and Prātimokṣas of the Dharmaguptaka, Mahīśāsaka, Sarvāstivāda (preserved in Chinese and Sanskrit fragments), Mūlasarvāstivāda (in Chinese and Tibetan), Mahāsāṅghika, and Lokottaravāda (in Sanskrit) traditions [SuttaCentral]. Algorithmic text-reuse analysis via DharmaNexus indicates extensive formulaic sharing within the Pali canon, matching most closely with the subsequent dietary rules of *Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga* Pāṭidesanīya 2–8 (sharing over 5,500 characters) and the monks' equivalent dietary rule in *Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga* Pācittiya 39 (Bu-Vb Pc39) [DharmaNexus]. Cross-language alignments in DharmaNexus identify strong textual concordance with the Tibetan Kangyur translation of the *Bhikṣuṇīvinayavibhaṅga* (D0005, 23 matches) and the *Vinaya-uttaragrantha* (D0007), reinforcing the curated Mūlasarvāstivāda parallels [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
